diagnosis: The customer is requesting audit logs from September of the previous year, which likely exceeds the 400-day retention period defined for their premium tier. The response should clarify the retention window and confirm that data outside this window is unavailable, without promising any recovery methods.
reply: Thank you for contacting support regarding your audit log request. According to our retention policy for your plan tier, audit log entries are retained for 400 days. As the entries from September of last year fall outside this retention window, they are no longer available for export. You can still access and export any logs within the current 400-day period via the audit endpoint.
